invariants.rationale: rollback method always returns the output of execute(), which should not be null since it represents rollback metadata.
rollbackInstantTime is required to construct the CopyOnWriteRollbackActionExecutor for execution.
commitInstant parameter is also required for constructing the underlying RollbackActionExecutor and cannot be null.
context is a required dependency and must be non-null to correctly execute the rollback logic.
The returned object must always be an instance of HoodieRollbackMetadata, as per method contract.
